sourceReceipts.finding: The page publishes province, canton and district selectors and the canton, distrito and codigo JSON endpoints. It is assignment observation authority, not Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry or a bulk-data licence.
Seven provinces, 84 cantons and 493 enabled district rows produce 493 unique five-digit codes. The raw observation remains outside Git.
The reviewed service terms do not grant nationwide postal assignment processing, derivation, redistribution or public-serving rights.
The page states transparency and free access to information. Free access is not an explicit bulk reuse, derivative, redistribution or public API-serving licence.

The official page links the exact archive and explains that UGED follows identifiable physical, infrastructure or cultural features and avoids some imaginary DTA limits. It is geostatistical reference geometry, not operator-issued postal geometry.

The archive has 492 unique COD_UGED Polygon features in CR-SIRGAS epoch 2014.59 / CRTM05 (EPSG:8908), zero empty geometry and zero OGC-invalid geometry. Its ISO metadata reports last update 2024-12-31.

The resource metadata marks access and use as Copyright, requires origin/property attribution, but leaves useLimitation empty. The public site footer advertises CC BY-SA 4.0, yet archive-level applicability to derived and redistributed geometry is not explicit in the member metadata.

applicationAssessment.reasonBrowserE2eNotRun: No rights-cleared, one-to-one or explicitly dated alias-aware current CR postal Polygon/MultiPolygon artifact exists; browser execution would validate only shared code or the synthetic fixture and cannot promote CR to M2.

blocker.summary: The current operator observation and UGED geometry do not form a rights-cleared, one-to-one or dated alias-aware release eligible for AGID public area serving.
reasons: Correos returns 493 enabled unique codes while UGED contains 492 unique district polygons; 60702 exists only in Correos, and both 60702 and 61301 are enabled Puerto Jiménez rows without validity or supersession fields.
Correos publishes free interactive access but no explicit licence for nationwide extraction, derivation, redistribution and public API/map serving.
UGED archive metadata marks Copyright and attribution, leaves useLimitation missing and does not explicitly bind the public-site CC BY-SA footer to the downloadable archive and derived output.
UGED is source-specific geostatistical geometry that deliberately differs from some imaginary DTA limits and is not operator-issued postal geometry.
unblockConditions: Obtain or identify written Correos terms permitting the intended nationwide processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving.
Resolve 60702 and 61301 with authoritative validity, alias or supersession dates and a documented mapping to current Puerto Jiménez geometry without guessing.

Confirm in writing or resource metadata that UGED geometry and derived AGID artifacts may be processed, transformed, redistributed and publicly served under a compatible licence with attribution/share-alike obligations implemented.
Build a reproducible fixed-receipt transform, preserve UGED geostatistical classification, validate CRS/topology/digests and publish no non-area or address/building proxy.
Drive the real CR API/application through normalization, unique/multiple/no-match/error/invalid-geometry states, fit, translucent render, metadata display, clear and re-search.
